description: Over the past eight years, we have developed unique actuator systems and AI, commercializing an android that now serves the US enterprise markets. We believe that our new name, 1X, better reflects who we are as a company and our vision to augment labor using androids.

Active Surfaces is commercializing cost-competitive, thin-film solar cell technology to expand the serviceable market for solar energy. The company builds on industry-leading cell performance derived from decades of MIT research.
Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

At Argo, we are building infrastructure for the future of space. We believe the next great leap beyond Earth requires re-imagining in-space transportation – transitioning to a new paradigm of abundant, unconstrained movement. We are untethering space operations from Earth by leveraging the moon’s shallow gravity well and accessible water resources. Argo will harvest lunar water and use it as propellant to create a true in-space transportation network. By sourcing propellant from the moon, we will provide the freedom to maneuver throughout space. This freedom will expand the possibilities for space businesses and support permanent human presence beyond Earth. Harnessing Lunar water will help usher in a new era of affordable activity in space.

Atomic Alchemy is developing a novel reactor to establish a reliable, domestically sourced supply chain for radioisotopes. It is positioned to be the first commercially scalable, end-to-end radioisotope producer.

Axiom Space is a private American company that operates human spaceflight missions to the International Space Station (ISS) and is developing its own commercial space station, Axiom Station, which is planned to succeed the ISS. The company provides comprehensive services for space agencies, private companies, and individuals, including astronaut training, mission management, and hardware development. Axiom Space also designs and builds next-generation spacesuits for both low-Earth orbit and lunar missions, contributing to a growing space economy by providing access to microgravity for research, data, and advanced manufacturing.
BioOrbit develops microgravity-based solutions for scalable protein crystallization and drug discovery.

Brelyon is an MIT spin-off introducing the first-ever, headset-free 122” virtual display for gaming and enterprise applications. The technology uses novel physics with optical and computational techniques to create true depth and panorama, replicating a cinema-like experience in a 32” monitor form factor.
A last-mile delivery service that deploys human-operated sidewalk robots to transport goods from merchants to their customers

Space weather has been a key challenge to space infrastructure from satellites to human exploration. With its state-of-the-art composite materials and forecasting systems, CSC can mitigate billions in yearly space radiation damage to satellites and launch vehicles while further enabling safe passage for human beings in space.
Cuby develops advanced construction technologies, both hardware and software, that help solve challenges within the construction economy by deploying mobile micro-factories globally.

Daanaa's chip-based technology enables bidirectional wireless power transfer with an optional data layer in a way that is integrated, safe, and free from constraints. Their technology integrates with existing hardware ranging from solar, electric vehicles, battery management solutions, household and office devices, and, in the future, the infrastructure that powers our homes and places of work.

Emerge is a social virtual connection company that develops a device where users can take virtual gatherings with tactile effects and interactions. Emerge Home™ is a virtual gathering space to physically feel, connect, and play with loved ones through visuals, audio, and touch with bare hands - enabled by a new category of a consumer device.

Esusu is a financial technology platform that leverages data solutions to help residents and improve property performance. Esusu was created on the premise that no matter where you come from, the color of your skin, and your financial identity should never determine where you end up in life. This allows renters to build and establish their credit scores while helping property owners mitigate against initiating evictions, powered by differentiated data and insights.
summary: Leveraging the power of data to bridge the racial wealth gap

description: GDC leverages hybrid drone technology to capitalize on long-range, heavy-payload cargo transportation.

Gravitics, Inc. designs and manufactures large space structures, forming the building blocks for human life in space. Through innovative, scalable space stations, Gravitics is helping grow the number of people living and working in space.
summary: Gravitics is bringing high-quality shipyard-style fabrication to the aerospace industry

description: Groq® LPU AI inference technology is a hardware and software platform that delivers exceptional AI compute speed, quality, and energy efficiency. Groq, headquartered in Silicon Valley, provides large-scale cloud and on-prem solutions for AI applications. The LPU and related systems are designed and manufactured in North America.

Hubble Network is building a satellite network that interfaces directly with off-the-shelf Bluetooth technology, providing connectivity to billions of IoT devices globally. It aims to bridge the 80% of the globe that lacks connectivity solutions for low-power devices.
summary: Connecting all bluetooth devices in the world

description: Interstellar Lab is pioneering biofarming solutions that boost production of high-value bioactive compounds in plants and provide a sustainable and scalable source of plant materials.
summary: Controlled-environment biofarms to unleash the power of plants on earth and in space

description: A single downstream gene is unable to reverse complex diseases of aging. Transcription factors are upstream “manager” genes that can return aged, diseased cells to health. Junevity's founders spent six years at UCSF creating a next-generation approach to rejuvenation. Junevity invented a new discovery platform to identify novel targets to treat age-related diseases. REWIND builds on innovations in genomics, machine learning, CRISPR, and aging biology.
summary: Rewinding diseases of aging with novel transcription factor medicines

description: Kitchen Data Systems (KitchData/KDS) empowers real restaurants and 'virtual' Delivery-1st brands to succeed in the digital age. The company’s data-driven process matches its KitchPartner restaurants with celebrities, influencers, sports teams and other existing brands to launch new dining experiences. An innovative business model enables real restaurants cooking real food to grow sales by helping established brands accelerate their Delivery-1st business. KitchData’s proprietary platform leverages restaurants' expertise to extend brands’ popularity equity. Key elements of the offering include: KitchPartner Network b2b marketplace; KitchSavers Club group purchasing service; and Kitch BrandBuilder marketing toolset. These components add new revenue streams for all parties, scaling bigger, better and faster than low quality ghost kitchens.

Lunar Outpost creates technologies that enable a sustainable presence in cislunar space while driving a positive impact here on Earth. With product lines focused on robotics and advanced instrumentation Lunar Outpost has helped create the first oxygen on Mars as part of the Perseverance mission, has the first ever contract to sell space resources(specifically lunar resources) to NASA, and has successfully created product line from advanced technology work. Key products include the commercial lunar rover MAPP that can provide mobility to a variety of payloads on the lunar surface, and the Canary Air Quality and Monitoring System, an IoT system, which has collected over 20 Billion unique data points to date in over 20 different states.
Space-based manufacturing company that develops 3D printers on board the ISS
summary: Space-based manufacturing company that develops 3D printers on board the ISS

description: Moons is a health, wellness, and fitness company that offers dental services. Its services feature a new way to straighten teeth without using braces by providing transparent aligners. they create a 3D model of teeth, then, one of their specialists will design treatment.

Natilus is developing next-generation cargo aircraft with a blended-wing-body design that improves aerodynamic efficiency, reduces drag, and lowers operating costs. These aircraft provide double the cargo volume while significantly reducing operational expenses.

Neuralink develops a brain-machine interface that provides solutions for those with paralysis. Neuralink engages in the development of high-bandwidth brain-machine interfaces. It is driven to build devices that will help people with paralysis and invent new technologies that will expand their abilities and community.
summary: A brain-machine interface that provides solutions for those with paralysis

description: OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company that aims to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.
summary: AI systems more intelligent than humans—benefit all of humanity

description: Orbit Fab offers a supply of satellite propellant in Earth Orbit that expands the operational potential of new and existing space assets. It develops the infrastructure needed to grow a thriving in-space market for products and services that support both existing space businesses (communications and Earth observation) and new industries like space tourism, manufacturing, and mining. The future for satellites is no longer restricted to the fuel they are launched with.

Outpost is redefining global logistics at orbital scale. The CarryAll™ platform launches aboard commercial rockets, operates in orbit, and executes a controlled hypersonic glide to deliver multi-ton payloads to designated locations anywhere on Earth in under 90 minutes. This fully reusable vehicle also returns high-value materials manufactured in microgravity, enabling secure point-to-point delivery and a new class of just-in-time space manufacturing with direct Earth integration.

Plaid is the technology platform providing the tools and access needed for the development of a fully modern, and digitally-enabled financial system. Plaid makes it easier and safer for developers — from the smallest startups to the largest financial institutions — to build innovative financial services and applications. Plaid offers beautiful consumer experiences, developer-friendly infrastructure, and intelligence tools that give everyone the ability to build the future of financial services.

PsiQuantum is a quantum computing company on a mission to build and deploy the world's first useful quantum computers. PsiQuantum was founded on the premise that photonic qubits, together with leverage of mature semiconductor manufacturing processes, could provide a fast path to a commercially useful, million-qubit quantum computer. Now, PsiQuantum builds thousands of wafers of quantum chips in a tier-1 foundry, operates cryogenic cabinets designed to support hundreds of chips, and is optimizing fault-tolerant algorithms that will solve valuable problems using our first-generation computers.

Radian Aerospace (Radian) is disrupting the aerospace industry with a next generation aerospace vehicle that is the world’s first fully reusable horizontal takeoff and landing, single-stage to orbit spaceplane, delivering people and light cargo to low earth orbit (LEO) and multiple terrestrial destinations with aircraft-like operations.
summary: Horizontal take off and Horizontal Landing Space Plane

description: RoboTire automates vehicle maintenance using software, computer vision, and robotics, starting with 10-minute tire replacements. The company was founded in 2018 by Victor Darolfi and is headquartered in San Carlos, California, United States.
Science Corporation is a clinical-stage medical technology company that works restore quality of life to those with debilitating conditions.

Signaloid provides a transparent, cloud-based computing platform that lets its customers understand how much to trust data output from computations. The company is developing a novel microprocessor that allows it’s customers to complete calculations over 50x faster than current technology, offering near real time results for critical decision making.

Cardiff, Wales, United Kingdom, Space Forge is building a factory in Space, the ForgeStar. Through their ForgeStar platform Space Forge is building high value materials that can only be made in Space for the use on earth in such cases like advanced semiconductors, fiber optic cables, and pharmaceuticals. Type One Ventures led Space Forge’s $10.2M seed round and Tarek Waked sits on the board. Co-founder Joshua Western is also now an advisor to Type One Ventures.
summary: In Space Manufacturing high value materials returned to earth

description: TOffeeAM generates and optmizes novel product designs for manufacturing using physics based ML models. TOffeeAM creates structures within smart industrial production, such as coolant systems for gas turbines exceeding the performance of current heat exchangers. The company has customers across a wide range of industries including aerospace, automotive and energy.
TurinTech transforms the business world with the next generation of AI optimization, reshaping how AI is built and used.
XAI is an AI company with a mission to advance scientific discovery and gain a deeper understanding of our universe.
